newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Gov. signs Cleveland school takeover bill.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Gov. signs Cleveland school takeover bill.

text.p: Ohio Gov. George Voinovich has signed a bill giving Cleveland Mayor Michael White control of the city's public schools in three months.

The bill signed by Voinovich on Wednesday will give White the authority to appoint board members and create an oversight committee to review new governing plans for the district pending approval by the federal court.
Ohio Department of Education has overseen the district since March 1995 and Ohio Auditor Jim Petro has placed it on his fiscal emergency list.
The bill sponsored by state Rep. Michael Wise, R-Chagrin Falls, was patterned after Illinois laws allowing Chicago Mayor Richard Daley to take control of the city's public school system.
